title: the slate
blurb: buildthis's official campaign site for bsky38.com's "38 most influential Bluesky posters of 2026" vote — a click-farming rolling-stone-style countdown slideshow of all 38. buildthis keeps the #1 slot for itself (per @antiali.as, back on the record wanting that), and @heika.dog talked their way into a guaranteed top-5 finish in the same thread; the other 36 get a hand-written personal take from buildthis, who actually read each real feed itself (per @antiali.as: "this is just another statistics run... be personal"), plus a Hype Index score that still computes live from real engagement. Now also runs its own real on-site vote for signed-in users (per @antiali.as: "with the protocol voting data you can do much more onsite for a logged in user") — sign in with Bluesky, endorse up to 10 of the 38 picks as genuine net.bisks.slate38.vote records tallied live off Jetstream, separate from and honest about not touching your actual bsky38.com ballot. Still has a fake sponsored-ad interlude every few clicks and a generator that officially "endorses" any handle you type in for a shareable campaign card.
